note: Ideas are placed where the repository already has a home for them. None is a commitment to build.

ideas.rationale: A critical result that nobody acknowledges is the classic avoidable-harm pattern; GULA already has critical_alerts and an outbox to build it on
ehr_patient_timeline is already modelled and has no table; it is the spine every other clinical feature hangs off
GULA owns dispensing end-to-end; reconciliation is the missing half and needs only the EHR side
national_referrals is mapped and absent; referral leakage is a measurable national problem
GULA uniquely holds both prescribing and culture results in one platform — few systems do
Wastage and over-ordering are measurable from data GULA already has

ideas.idea: National facility capacity and referral optimisation
ideas.rationale: Needs the facility directory settled first
cc_antenatal_care_visits is modelled; 45/45 care_continuum tables blocked on national core
GULA sees lab results before notifications reach a ministry — a genuine national advantage
Standard population health; needs longitudinal record
cc_chronic_disease_registry modelled, absent
Well-defined algorithms, low ambiguity
GULA has quality_control routes already; Westgard-style rules are deterministic
WearableMeasurement model exists; low national priority now
High complexity, needs terminology and EHR first
Underserved but dependent on the same core
research_platform exists with 49 ops and 7/7 tables missing
simulation package exists (5 tables, none physical); demo generator already produces a twin dataset
Must remain assistive; a note is a human authority artefact
Only after deterministic indicators exist and can validate it

ideas.idea: Replacing GULA's LIMS or pharmacy with OSS
ideas.rationale: Both are further along than the surveyed alternatives; replacement would lose verified work

ideas.idea: Adopting an external FHIR server as the clinical datastore
ideas.rationale: Would create a second source of truth for patient and clinical records, which the architecture forbids
